Contract ManageLibrarianCRUDService::createLibrarian(librarianid: String,name: String,password: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		librarian: Librarian = Librarian.allInstance()->any(o|o.LibrarianID = librarianId),
		success: Boolean = true
	precondition:
		librarian.oclIsUndefined() = true
	postcondition:
		let newLibrarian: Librarian in
		newLibrarian.oclIsNew() and
		Librarian.allInstance()->includes(newLibrarian) and
		newLibrarian.LibrarianID = librarianId and
		newLibrarian.Name = name and
		newLibrarian.Password = password and
		result = success
}
